items.title: Canada has qualified for the 2027 FIBA Men's World Cup.
items.author: Blake Murphy
items.body_excerpt:
Canada has qualified for the 2027 FIBA Men's World Cup.

Bahamas lose to Argentina, and now even the most bizarre tiebreaker scenarios are off the table.

3 qualifying window games to go for Canada, but they're in.

quote.author: Blake Murphy
quote.text:
Canada has its first loss in 2027 FIBA Men's World Cup qualifying.

A big late comeback falls short vs Uruguay, for an 84-78 loss.

Canada now 8-1 (+152) and can still qualify with 1 win or Bahamas loss.

Back at it Sunday.
